name: query_request.py
summary: DRF serializer for validating and transforming incoming query request payloads
purpose: Provides a structured validation layer between the API view and the query execution domain, ensuring that all incoming query requests conform to expected schema and business rules before processing
responsibilities: Validate incoming query request data against defined schema
Deserialize JSON payload into Python native types
Serialize query request models or instances for API responses
Enforce business rules and input sanitization
Act as a contract between the client and the query domain
inputs: Raw user input for query execution
architecture_notes: Implements the Serializer pattern from Django REST Framework to decouple API representation from internal domain models. Located in the queries app serializers layer, it enforces the Single Responsibility Principle by isolating request validation logic from views and models. Typically used as part of a layered architecture where the view delegates input parsing to the serializer before passing clean data to a service or repository layer for actual query execution.
improvements: Add explicit type hints and docstrings to improve maintainability
Implement custom validators for security-sensitive inputs (e.g., SQL injection prevention if applicable)
Add comprehensive unit tests covering edge cases and invalid inputs
Consider splitting read and write responsibilities into separate List/Detail serializers if complexity grows
Add logging for validation failures to support monitoring and debugging
